_approach: Funk automotivo built for car-audio systems: a relentless, near four-on-the-floor kick built for trunk-rattling sub weight, with a driving 16th kick-roll ('tuim'-style) across beat 3 that ramps into beat 4, and a minimal, loop-driven arrangement — clap only on 2 and 4, everything else left as empty space for the bass. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
